chunks: They said, 'We have given you the happy tidings of a truth,' so do not be one of those who despair.

key_terms.بَشَّرْنَاكَ: We have given you glad tidings

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'do not be of those who despair' mean in the context of divine revelation?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Hud, this verse addresses Prophet Lut (AS) after the angels deliver the glad tidings of a righteous son, urging him not to despair despite the impending destruction of his people. Shia exegesis highlights this as a lesson in steadfastness (istiqamah) for the Imams and believers, emphasizing that divine promise remains certain even when circumstances seem dire. It reinforces the theological principle that hope in God's mercy should never waver, regardless of external trials.
